search.snippet: The steel kiteshield is the fourth-best smithable kiteshield, requiring 5 Defence to wield. A player with 42 Smithing can make the shield by using three steel bars on an anvil while carrying a hammer, granting 112.5 Smithing experience. It can be purchased at Seddu's Adventurer's Store in Nardah. Cassie's Shield Shop in Falador, however, usually has none in stock.
